multi_entity_note: Two parties: Coral Gold Resources Ltd. (Company) and Intermark Capital Corp. (Consultant), plus the Principal David Wolfin.
processing_note: All notices required or permitted under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be given by delivering such notice or mailing such notice by pre-paid registered mail, by facsimile transmission or electronic mail to the addresses provided under the names of each party on the first page to this Agreement.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading, Section 21.1(a) and Schedule A name it the Consulting Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is dated for reference the 1st day of February, 2020; the actual execution date is not stated.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The preamble defines the Effective Date as 1 February 2020, restated in Section 21.1(n).

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Section 4.2 says the five-year Term ends on January 31, 2025, repeated in Section 5.3.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 18.1: governed by the laws of the Province of British Columbia and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Despite the "Term and Renewal" heading, no renewal term is provided; the agreement terminates automatically at expiry.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no renewal; the 3-month notices are for early termination, not for preventing renewal.
